name: horn
description: Leeway's city car horns (engine/audio/voices.hpp, CityNoise, its horn layer), one horn at full loudness. An event every 5 .. 18 s of 1 or 2 beeps (even odds); each event draws its pitch, 380 .. 470 Hz, and its beep length, 0.18 .. 0.35 s; the beeps start length + 0.12 s apart. Each beep: two sines, at the pitch and at 1.25 times it, each through tanh(3 x), mixed 1 : 0.7, low-passed at 1500 Hz, with a 10 ms attack and a release at the beep's end; then Leeway's horns 0.3 and master 0.8 into tanh. The first event comes at 4 s, as Leeway's. No inputs: distance and stereo placement (Leeway's cityPlacement, cityReference and rolloff) are the adapter's job, not this recipe's. Deviations: the release is exponential (time constant 10 ms, starting 20 ms before the beep's end) where Leeway's is a linear 20 ms ramp to zero at the end; the wait for the next event starts at the last beep's start, where Leeway's starts after that beep and its 0.12 s gap, so events come 0.30 .. 0.47 s sooner; Leeway's second sine wraps its phase together with the first (a small step once per cycle), ours is a clean sine; both sines restart their phase at each beep and keep running between beeps, where Leeway's pause; the pitch and length reach the sines and the envelope once per 128-sample control block.
